title: macOS BYOD Management — Account-Driven User Enrollment, App Protection & Conditional Access
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (macOS + Microsoft Intune/Entra; configuration/identity/security work, live-fleet care).
White-label; Apple/Microsoft console internals authored click-by-click from public docs; anything uncertain flagged, not invented.
hook: Secure company data on personal Macs without owning them
problem: Personal Macs accessing company resources need protection without heavy-handed control over the user's device. This solution builds a macOS BYOD strategy: account-driven user enrollment for a lighter management footprint, Conditional Access that requires compliance/enrollment for access, and an honest treatment of what app protection can and can't do on macOS — so corporate data is protected on non-corporate Macs, deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — BYOD models for Macs (account-driven user enrollment vs device enrollment vs unmanaged + Conditional Access), what management footprint each carries, and the honest note that Intune App Protection Policies do not cover macOS apps the way they do iOS/Android — protection comes via MDM scope + Conditional Access.
Requirements Guide — prerequisites (Entra + Intune, account-driven enrollment prerequisites, Conditional Access, a pilot) with how to verify/implement each.

Implementation Guide — exact steps to enable account-driven user enrollment, scope BYOD compliance, build the named Conditional Access policy (require compliant/enrolled Mac), assign to a pilot, validate, and expand.
5 PowerShell scripts — BYOD-readiness discovery, per-device enrollment/compliance validation, a BYOD access-posture report, safe remediation, and a target-group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (personal Mac enrolls, compliant, CA allows) plus Best Practices for privacy and least footprint.
short: Build a macOS BYOD strategy — account-driven user enrollment, Conditional Access that gates on compliance, and an honest app-protection model — to secure company data on personal Macs, pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: Build a macOS BYOD strategy — account-driven user enrollment, Conditional Access that gates on compliance, and an honest app-protection model — to secure company data on personal Macs, pilot-first.

bottom_line: Company data protected on personal Macs — the right enrollment model and Conditional Access, without over-managing the user's device — proven on a pilot before you scale.
